transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining the finalization huddle. As you know, we've got the Ash Harbor callbacks coming up on June 18 at Studio 4, 9 AM to 1 PM, with three finalists for the Mara Quill role. The draft package includes the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. Before I issue the call sheet, I need each of you — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling — to review the callback package. Let's go around and hear any concerns or flags from your areas.
